text: Peterson Why are you running for office? What makes 2024 different than when you last ran? If Republicans retain control of Congress, or if we have a Republican administration, how would you work with them? If you do win and Democrats have the majority, how would you represent a majority conservative state with a liberal majority? Who would you support as Speaker? Are there any policy areas where you differ from Vice President Harris? SHAKE UPS You’ve criticized Congress saying you “support campaign finance reform, term limits, and want to prevent stock trades in Congress.” What kind of campaign finance reform would you like to see? You can’t do that alone. How would approach those goals and how do shake the norm in an institution? ABORTION You’ve said one of your top goals is abortion choice, but you live in a state with a very conservative Legislature. Idahoans continue to overwhelmingly vote for anti-abortion policymakers who support abortion laws being left up to the states. How would you balance your beliefs with what these constituents seemingly want?) -Are there areas where you would make concessions to work with Republicans (month of viability, exemptions, etc)? -(If it doesn’t otherwise come up) Would you support legislation in Congress to legalize abortion nationwide? SOC SECURITY You said you’d vote for the Social Security Expansion Act. Walk me through your rational behind that? EDUCATION How do plan to improve public schools in Idaho when our Legislature, each elected by the people of their district, allocates that funding and might have different views than you on how schools should operate? HEALTH CARE You’ve talked about how strenuous the cost of health care can be, but what do you plan to do to reduce that cost, especially for families in Idaho? VA What would you do to improve care for veterans through the VA? GROUNDWATER The Biden-Harris administration has established a Council on groundwater which Gov. Little and some members of congress have adamantly pushed back against. Where do you stand around the management of groundwater and ensuring that Idaho farmers have what they need while balancing federal concerns around drought and climate change? How about federal land management? Should the federal government more actively manage the federal lands in Idaho to reduce fuel load? FENTANYL: One major area of concern for both Congress and Gov. Little is fentanyl coming into our country. What do you think the federal government should do on this front? Roth Why are you running for office? What makes 2024 different than when you last ran? Are there any policy areas where you differ from Vice President Harris? ABORTION You’ve said “I will vote to restore Roe v. Wade, ensuring that bodily autonomy is once again recognized and protected for all women,” but how do you do that without a seat on Supreme Court? Do you believe there could be a national abortion access law and what would like to you? (month of viability, exemptions, etcs) IVF You criticized Rep. Simpson for his support of the Life and Conception Act because it could have created an IVF ban. Knowing that there are Congressmen who support this, how do you work together to support Idaho families? LBGTQ ISSUES You’re passionate about LBGTQ issues and protections. In recent years there have been many pieces of legislation focused on the rights and health care of transgender people, both in Idaho and nationally. How would you work with people from the opposite party to pass meaningful legislation? ECONOMOY Your campaign has talked about supporting small and local businesses. If elected, what policies can do that in a meaningful way? CLIMATE CHANGE Climate change is something your campaign has touched on. If elected, what do you see as action that the country could effectively do to address it? How do you work with some fellow Congressmen who wouldn’t support those efforts?? GROUNDWATER Something on groundwater?
